responses.content: No, the Great Wall of China is not visible from space with the naked eye. While the Great Wall of China is an impressive structure, it is not visible from low Earth orbit or the Moon. The idea that it can be seen from space is a common misconception. Astronauts in orbit have reported that while they can see large geographical features, the Great Wall is not one of them.
